servers.name: sequential-thinking
servers.comment: Chain-of-thought scratchpad tool — verified on npm 2026-10-04. Useful for complex multi-step reasoning; the agent calls it to externalize its thinking.

servers.name: memory
servers.comment: Persistent knowledge graph (entities + relations). Storage path defaults to ~/.agentkthx/memory.json so the graph survives restarts.

servers.name: time
servers.comment: Date/time tools (current_time, convert_timezone, add_to_date, date_diff, cron_next_runs, business_days, format_date). Replaces the removed get_time/get_date built-in tools. Uses the system timezone by default.

servers.name: audit
servers.comment: Phase 2 — kthx-audit MCP server. See docs/mcp/ROADMAP.md. Disabled until implemented.
